settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person Pacific realism on Peleliu, September 1944. U.S. Marine POV, coral sand, oppressive heat, broken palms, airfield, limestone ridges, dust and water scarcity. Non-graphic and physically believable.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Marines; Japanese defenders remain clearly separate in caves, ridges and opposing terrain. Weapon state varies naturally.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person island reenactment with glare, sweat, heat shimmer, coral dust, exhausted body motion and quiet recovery beats.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP10 — Peleliu: Heat and Coral
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. Marine lands on Peleliu, crosses hot coral ground, moves past the airfield, rests in shade and reaches rough limestone cover as the day burns on.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make heat itself part of the story. Use sweat, glare, dry mouth, coral dust and short movement. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: White Surf
scenes.actionDescription: He steps from landing craft into shallow surf.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Marine legs in bright surf, coral beach, Marines ahead, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wade forward. Audio: surf, engine, gear, breath.

scenes.title: Coral Under Boots
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs coarse coral sand that slips under boots.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person boots in pale coral grit, heat glare, palms damaged ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy upward steps. Audio: grit, breath, distant battle.

scenes.title: Helmet Heat
scenes.actionDescription: He wipes sweat from brow and adjusts helmet.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sweaty glove, helmet rim, bright washed sky, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wipe and exhale. Audio: breath, insects, distant guns.

scenes.title: Palm Stump Cover
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches behind shattered palm trunk and scans inland.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person charred palm cover, open coral ground, distant separated enemy ridge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low scan left to right. Audio: wind, distant bursts, breath.

scenes.title: Short Dash
scenes.actionDescription: He runs a short exposed stretch toward an earth scrape.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint over pale coral, rifle offset, Marines ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast dash and drop. Audio: boots, gear, breath, distant fire.

scenes.title: Dry Canteen
scenes.actionDescription: He tips canteen and gets only a small swallow.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen, dusty glove, coral berm, weapon resting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Small drink, shake empty canteen. Audio: metal, swallow, wind.

scenes.title: Airfield Reveal
scenes.actionDescription: He rises enough to see the broad airfield and smoke beyond.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide airfield, heat shimmer, Marines in friendly foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise to wide reveal. Audio: wind, distant engines, guns.

scenes.title: Across the Strip
scenes.actionDescription: He follows squad across a narrow section of airfield.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person running feet, runway surface, rifle low, friendly Marines ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Short run. Audio: boots, breath, distant fire.

scenes.title: Shade at Last
scenes.actionDescription: He sits in narrow shade beside damaged earthwork.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person knees in shadow, dusty gloves, bright glare beyond.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still. Audio: insects, breath, distant battle.

scenes.title: Water Handoff
scenes.actionDescription: A Marine passes him a partly filled canteen.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen handoff between USMC sleeves, no speech.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff and drink. Audio: metal, swallow, breath.

scenes.title: Limestone Ahead
scenes.actionDescription: He studies jagged limestone ridges through haze.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rough ridges, cave shadows distant and separate, hand shading eyes.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow look toward ridge. Audio: wind, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Climb the Rock
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs broken limestone using both hands.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty hands on sharp pale rock, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Careful climb. Audio: stone scrape, gear, breath.

scenes.title: Cave Distance
scenes.actionDescription: He remains behind rock watching a distant cave opening without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rock cover, distant opposing cave mouth, friendly ridge foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still watch. Audio: wind, insects, distant sounds.

scenes.title: Sun Lowering
scenes.actionDescription: He looks at dust-caked hands in warmer late light.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty hands, orange light on limestone, rifle off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow hand inspection. Audio: wind, breath.

scenes.title: Into the Ridges
scenes.actionDescription: He follows the squad deeper along the ridge route.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person tired walk, Marines ahead, limestone and smoke, evening light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward walk. Audio: boots, gear, wind, tired breath. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.mainOutfit: USMC field uniform, helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Marines. Japanese defenders remain clearly separate. Preserve heat, coral dust, sweat and gear continuity.

atmosphereAssets.title: Peleliu Beach
atmosphereAssets.description: Bright coral landing beach and shattered palms.

atmosphereAssets.title: Airfield Sector
atmosphereAssets.description: Open runway, coral berms and narrow shade.

atmosphereAssets.title: Limestone Ridge Approach
atmosphereAssets.description: Jagged limestone, separated cave positions and rough ascent.
